question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Narcopolis’?
solution:
The correct answer is** Jeet Thayil.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Point__**

__
 
• **Narcopolis **is the debut novel of Indian author** Jeet Thayil**, which was shortlisted for the **2012 Man Booker Prize.**
 
• It is set in **1970s Old Bombay **and concerns opium and its influence.
 
• The **novel's narrator arrives in Bombay**, where he becomes seduced into the opium underground.
 
• **Jeet Thayil** is an Indian poet, novelist, librettist, and musician.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shashi Tharoor** is an Indian former international diplomat, politician, and writer.
 
• **David Davidar **is an Indian novelist and publisher. 
 
• **Anees Salim** is an Indian author.
